subject: Web Development
title: Web Sustainability
description: A fast breakdown of Web Sustainability for builders.

hook.text: The internet consumes roughly 10% of global electricity. Data centers emit more CO2 than airlines.

buildup.text: Every page view requires server processing, data transfer, and device rendering — all using energy.

discovery.text: Sustainable web design minimizes page weight, reduces requests, and chooses green hosting.

twist.text: AI workloads are exploding energy consumption. Training one large model emits tons of CO2.

climax.text: The web must grow responsibly. Performance optimization and sustainability share the same toolkit.

punchline.text: A lighter web is a greener web.

quiz.question: What percentage of global electricity does the internet use?
